title: Platelet N-glycan isomer profiles in control and FUT8-knockout mice
description: Fifty N-glycan chromatographic features quantified in platelet lysates from three control and three FUT8-knockout mouse observations, supporting a study of platelet activation and thrombosis.
details: The assay contains the six original area-under-curve columns C1–C3 and K1–K3. Isomer labels, retention times, precursor charge and mass, glycan class and author-assigned fucosyl linkage are retained. The separate normalized block in the source workbook contains fractions despite its percent heading; it is not duplicated as an independent dataset. Replicate biology beyond the author condition labels is not inferred.
annotation: Explicit total Hex, HexNAc, Fuc, NeuGc and NeuAc counts are used. Distinct chromatographic isomers remain distinct features. Core/outer-arm linkage information is retained as an author annotation and is not expanded into an unsupported complete glycan topology.
